jobs_results.job_title: Data Analyst Intern at VE Commercial Vehicles
jobs_results.description:
VE Commercial Vehicles is hiring a Data Analyst Intern in Pithampur. VE Commercial Vehicles is a OEM (commercial vehicles) and one of the most recognised names in the Indian automotive industry, and this internship places you inside a team that designs, builds and ships vehicles used by millions of people every day.

As a Data Analyst Intern at VE Commercial Vehicles Pithampur, you will work alongside experienced engineers and managers on live programmes rather than sample projects. You will spend time on the shop floor and in design reviews, learn how a product moves from concept to a road-ready vehicle, and take genuine ownership of a scoped piece of work.

What you will do:
• Support day-to-day data analyst work on active VE Commercial Vehicles programmes in Pithampur.
• Apply SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI, Python to real problems, with review and mentorship from senior engineers.
• Collect and analyse data, document your findings and present them to the team.
• Work cross-functionally with design, manufacturing, quality and supply-chain colleagues.
• Follow safety, quality and compliance standards expected in automotive manufacturing.

Who should apply:
• Students and recent graduates in engineering or a related discipline.
• Working knowledge of SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI — depth matters more than breadth.
• Curiosity about how vehicles are engineered and a willingness to learn on the floor.
• Strong communication and the discipline to document work clearly.

What you get: a monthly stipend of ₹20,000, a 2-month structured programme, mentorship from automotive professionals, and experience at VE Commercial Vehicles that carries real weight on an engineering CV.

If you want to build a career in the automobile industry in Pithampur, apply now — we would like to meet you. Responsibilities: Support data analyst work on live VE Commercial Vehicles programmes in Pithampur; Apply SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI to real engineering problems; Analyse data, document findings and present them to the team; Collaborate with design, manufacturing, quality and supply-chain teams. Requirements: Working knowledge of SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI, Python; Open to students and recent graduates; Interest in the automobile / mobility industry; Strong problem-solving, documentation and communication skills.

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst (Job Vacancy)
jobs_results.description:
The 
Data Analyst
 plays a crucial role in our organization, driving data-driven decision-making and contributing to the overall success of the team. This position offers an exciting opportunity for collaboration, innovation, and professional growth within a dynamic environment.

As a 
Data Analyst
, you will be responsible for transforming raw data into actionable insights that inform strategic initiatives. Your analytical skills will help shape our business strategies and enhance operational efficiency.


Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to identify trends and patterns that support business objectives.

Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that provide stakeholders with real-time insights into key performance indicators.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data needs and deliver tailored analytical solutions.

Utilize statistical methods to interpret data and generate useful business insights that drive decision-making.

Present findings and recommendations to management and stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner.

Monitor data quality and integrity, ensuring accuracy and reliability in all analyses.

Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in data analysis and visualization techniques.

Assist in the development of data governance policies and procedures to enhance data management practices.

Support ad-hoc analysis requests from various departments to facilitate informed decision-making.

Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for process optimization through data analysis.


To excel in this role, candidates should possess a strong foundation in data analysis and visualization tools, as well as a passion for leveraging data to drive business success.


Bachelors degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

Proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL, Python, or R.

Experience with data visualization software like Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, to convey complex data insights effectively.

Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

Familiarity with statistical analysis techniques and methodologies.

Experience in data cleaning and preparation processes.

Knowledge of database management systems and data warehousing concepts.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


This role not only offers the chance to work with cutting-edge data technologies but also provides a platform for personal and professional development within a forward-thinking organization.

jobs_results.job_title: Data Analyst – New Hope IVF & Fertility Center (Indore)
jobs_results.description:
Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh

Department: MIS / Data Analytics

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

New Hope IVF & Fertility Center is looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to support our team with data management, reporting, analysis, and business insights.

The ideal candidate should have strong Excel skills, good analytical ability, and the ability to prepare accurate reports and dashboards.

Key Responsibilities

- Collect, organize, clean, and maintain data from various sources.
- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
- Analyze data and identify trends, patterns, and discrepancies.
- Create and maintain Excel reports, dashboards, and presentations.
- Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare management reports.
- Ensure accuracy and consistency of data.
- Coordinate with different departments to collect and verify required information.
- Support management with data-driven reports and insights.
- Maintain proper documentation of reports and data.

Required Skills 
- Strong knowledge of MS Excel including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF, SUMIF/SUMIFS, COUNTIF/COUNTIFS, etc.
- Basic knowledge of SQL is preferred.
- Knowledge of Power BI/Tableau will be an advantage.
- Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Solid attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good communication and coordination skills.

Education & Experience 
- Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
- Freshers with strong Excel and analytical skills may also apply.
- Relevant experience in Data Analysis/MIS/Reporting will be preferred.

What We’re Looking For 
- Someone who is comfortable working with numbers and large datasets.
- Good attention to detail.
- Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple reports.
- Willingness to learn and work in a healthcare/IVF environment.

Location: Indore

Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits

- Cell phone reimbursement
- Commuter assistance
- Flexible schedule
- Internet reimbursement
- Leave encashment
- Paid time off
- Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
